## Episode Thesis

The episode discusses the recent weakening of the Swedish krona ahead of Q2 earnings season and summer holidays, attributing it to a stronger US dollar driven by higher American interest rate expectations, softer Swedish growth data, and lingering risk sentiment despite easing Iran-US tensions. The hosts note the krona has underperformed expectations even as a Middle East peace deal appeared to progress, and remark that the dollar has not strengthened as much as the rate differential would suggest, possibly reflecting eroding confidence in US policy predictability. No individual companies or stocks are discussed.
